lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਸਦਾ ਥਿਰੁ ਪੂਜਹੁ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: har ke sa(n)t sadaa thir poojahu jo har naam japaat ||
lines.translation: The Lord's Saints are steady and stable forever; they worship and adore Him, and chant the Lord's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਤ ਹੈ ਗੋਬਿਦੁ ਤੇ ਸਤਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਤ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jin kau kripaa karat hai gobid te satasa(n)g milaat ||3||
lines.translation: Those who are mercifully blessed by the Lord of the Universe, join the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਸੰਪਤਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਨ ਚਲਤ ਸੰਗਾਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: maat pitaa banitaa sut sa(n)pat a(n)t na chalat sa(n)gaat ||
lines.translation: Mother, father, spouse, children and wealth will not go along with you in the end.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਰਾਮ ਭਜੁ ਬਉਰੇ ਜਨਮੁ ਅਕਾਰਥ ਜਾਤ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kahat kabeer raam bhaj baure janam akaarath jaat ||4||1||
lines.translation: Says Kabeer, meditate and vibrate on the Lord, O madman. Your life is uselessly wasting away. ||4||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਜਾਸ੍ਰਮ ਮਿਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨੀ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: raajaasram mit nahee jaanee teree ||
lines.translation: I do not know the limits of Your Royal Ashram.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੇ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਹਉ ਚੇਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: tere sa(n)tan kee hau cheree ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: I am the humble slave of Your Saints. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਸਤੋ ਜਾਇ ਸੁ ਰੋਵਤੁ ਆਵੈ ਰੋਵਤੁ ਜਾਇ ਸੁ ਹਸੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: hasato jaai s rovat aavai rovat jaai s hasai ||
lines.translation: The one who goes laughing returns crying, and the one who goes crying returns laughing.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਸਤੋ ਹੋਇ ਹੋਇ ਸੋੁ ਊਜਰੁ ਊਜਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਬਸੈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: basato hoi hoi sou oojar oojar hoi s basai ||1||
lines.translation: What is inhabited becomes deserted, and what is deserted becomes inhabited. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਲ ਤੇ ਥਲ ਕਰਿ ਥਲ ਤੇ ਕੂਆ ਕੂਪ ਤੇ ਮੇਰੁ ਕਰਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jal te thal kar thal te kooaa koop te mer karaavai ||
lines.translation: The water turns into a desert, the desert turns into a well, and the well turns into a mountain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਰਤੀ ਤੇ ਆਕਾਸਿ ਚਢਾਵੈ ਚਢੇ ਅਕਾਸਿ ਗਿਰਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: dharatee te aakaas chadhaavai chadhe akaas giraavai ||2||
lines.translation: From the earth, the mortal is exalted to the Akaashic ethers; and from the ethers on high, he is thrown down again. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੇਖਾਰੀ ਤੇ ਰਾਜੁ ਕਰਾਵੈ ਰਾਜਾ ਤੇ ਭੇਖਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhekhaaree te raaj karaavai raajaa te bhekhaaree ||
lines.translation: The beggar is transformed into a king, and the king into a beggar.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਲ ਮੂਰਖ ਤੇ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਕਰਿਬੋ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਤੇ ਮੁਗਧਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: khal moorakh te pa(n)dit karibo pa(n)dit te mugadhaaree ||3||
lines.translation: The idiotic fool is transformed into a Pandit, a religious scholar, and the Pandit into a fool. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਰੀ ਤੇ ਜੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਕਰਾਵੈ ਪੁਰਖਨ ਤੇ ਜੋ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: naaree te jo purakh karaavai purakhan te jo naaree ||
lines.translation: The woman is transformed into a man, and the men into women.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਸਾਧੂ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: kahu kabeer saadhoo ko preetam tis moorat balihaaree ||4||2||
lines.translation: Says Kabeer, God is the Beloved of the Holy Saints. I am a sacrifice to His image. ||4||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰੰਗ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਜੀ ਕੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: saara(n)g baanee naamadeu jee kee ||
lines.translation: Saarang, The Word Of Naam Dayv Jee:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਏਂ ਰੇ ਮਨ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਬਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaae(n) re man bikhiaa ban jaai ||
lines.translation: O mortal, why are you going into the forest of corruption?

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੂਲੌ ਰੇ ਠਗਮੂਰੀ ਖਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhoolau re thagamooree khaai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: You have been misled into eating the toxic drug. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਮੀਨੁ ਪਾਨੀ ਮਹਿ ਰਹੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaise meen paanee mahi rahai ||
lines.translation: You are like a fish living in the water;

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਲ ਜਾਲ ਕੀ ਸੁਧਿ ਨਹੀ ਲਹੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaal jaal kee sudh nahee lahai ||
lines.translation: you do not see the net of death.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਹਬਾ ਸੁਆਦੀ ਲੀਲਿਤ ਲੋਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: jihabaa suaadee leelit loh ||
lines.translation: Trying to taste the flavor, you swallow the hook.

lines.gurmukhi: ਐਸੇ ਕਨਿਕ ਕਾਮਨੀ ਬਾਧਿਓ ਮੋਹ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: aise kanik kaamanee baadhio moh ||1||
lines.translation: You are bound by attachment to wealth and woman. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਮਧੁ ਮਾਖੀ ਸੰਚੈ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: jiu madh maakhee sa(n)chai apaar ||
lines.translation: The bee stores up loads of honey;

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਧੁ ਲੀਨੋ ਮੁਖਿ ਦੀਨੀ ਛਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: madh leeno mukh deenee chhaar ||
lines.translation: then someone comes and takes the honey, and throws dust in its mouth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਊ ਬਾਛ ਕਉ ਸੰਚੈ ਖੀਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: gaoo baachh kau sa(n)chai kheer ||
lines.translation: The cow stores up loads of milk;

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਲਾ ਬਾਂਧਿ ਦੁਹਿ ਲੇਇ ਅਹੀਰੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: galaa baa(n)dh duhi lei aheer ||2||
lines.translation: then the milkman comes and ties it by its neck and milks it. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾਰਨਿ ਸ੍ਰਮੁ ਅਤਿ ਕਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaiaa kaaran sram at karai ||
lines.translation: For the sake of Maya, the mortal works very hard.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਮਾਇਆ ਲੈ ਗਾਡੈ ਧਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: so maaiaa lai gaadai dharai ||
lines.translation: He takes the wealth of Maya, and buries it in the ground.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਤਿ ਸੰਚੈ ਸਮਝੈ ਨਹੀ ਮੂੜੑ ॥
lines.transliteration: at sa(n)chai samajhai nahee mooRh ||
lines.translation: He acquires so much, but the fool does not appreciate it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਧਰਤੀ ਤਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਗਇਓ ਧੂੜਿ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: dhan dharatee tan hoi gaio dhooR ||3||
lines.translation: His wealth remains buried in the ground, while his body turns to dust. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਤਿ ਜਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaam krodh trisanaa at jarai ||
lines.translation: He burns in tremendous sexual desire, unresolved anger and desire.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕਬਹੂ ਨਹੀ ਕਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: saadhasa(n)gat kabahoo nahee karai ||
lines.translation: He never joins the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਤ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਤਾ ਚੀ ਆਣਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: kahat naamadeu taa chee aan ||
lines.translation: Says Naam Dayv, seek God's Shelter;

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਭੈ ਹੋਇ ਭਜੀਐ ਭਗਵਾਨ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: nirabhai hoi bhajeeai bhagavaan ||4||1||
lines.translation: be fearless, and vibrate on the Lord God. ||4||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਦਹੁ ਕੀ ਨ ਹੋਡ ਮਾਧਉ ਮੋ ਸਿਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: badahu kee na hod maadhau mo siu ||
lines.translation: Why not make a bet with me, O Lord of Wealth?

lines.gurmukhi: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਤੇ ਜਨੁ ਜਨ ਤੇ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਖੇਲੁ ਪਰਿਓ ਹੈ ਤੋ ਸਿਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: thaakur te jan jan te thaakur khel pario hai to siu ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: From the master comes the servant, and from the servant, comes the master. This is the game I play with You. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਨ ਦੇਉ ਦੇਹੁਰਾ ਆਪਨ ਆਪ ਲਗਾਵੈ ਪੂਜਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: aapan deu dehuraa aapan aap lagaavai poojaa ||
lines.translation: You Yourself are the deity, and You are the temple of worship. You are the devoted worshipper.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਲ ਤੇ ਤਰੰਗ ਤਰੰਗ ਤੇ ਹੈ ਜਲੁ ਕਹਨ ਸੁਨਨ ਕਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jal te tara(n)g tara(n)g te hai jal kahan sunan kau doojaa ||1||
lines.translation: From the water, the waves rise up, and from the waves, the water. They are only different by figures of speech. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਹਿ ਗਾਵੈ ਆਪਹਿ ਨਾਚੈ ਆਪਿ ਬਜਾਵੈ ਤੂਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: aapahi gaavai aapahi naachai aap bajaavai tooraa ||
lines.translation: You Yourself sing, and You Yourself dance. You Yourself blow the bugle.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਤ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਜਨੁ ਊਰਾ ਤੂ ਪੂਰਾ ॥੨॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: kahat naamadeu too(n) mero thaakur jan ooraa too pooraa ||2||2||
lines.translation: Says Naam Dayv, You are my Lord and Master. Your humble servant is imperfect; You are perfect. ||2||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਾਸ ਅਨਿੰਨ ਮੇਰੋ ਨਿਜ ਰੂਪ ॥
lines.transliteration: daas ani(n)n mero nij roop ||
lines.translation: Says God: my slave is devoted only to me; he is in my very image.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨ ਨਿਮਖ ਤਾਪ ਤ੍ਰਈ ਮੋਚਨ ਪਰਸਤ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਰਤ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਕੂਪ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: darasan nimakh taap traee mochan parasat mukat karat grih koop ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The sight of him, even for an instant, cures the three fevers; his touch brings liberation from the deep dark pit of household affairs. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੀ ਬਾਂਧੀ ਭਗਤੁ ਛਡਾਵੈ ਬਾਂਧੈ ਭਗਤੁ ਨ ਛੂਟੈ ਮੋਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: meree baa(n)dhee bhagat chhadaavai baa(n)dhai bhagat na chhootai mohi ||
lines.translation: The devotee can release anyone from my bondage, but I cannot release anyone from his.
